title: Volcanoes of United Republic of Tanzania
intro: 10 volcanoes of United Republic of Tanzania, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Lengai, Ol Doinyo
rounds.fact: Lengai, Ol Doinyo is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1967. The data places it in United Republic of Tanzania.
